public_body: Masconomet Regional School District School Committee
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the March 6 minutes substantially complied with the accuracy and detail requirement, and the committee was not obligated to adopt the complainant's proposed revisions.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the March 6 minutes were insufficiently detailed, omitting her budget and School Choice comments and another speaker's School Choice comments.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Committee substantially complied with the requirement to provide an accurate and sufficiently detailed summary of the discussion topics.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee did not incorporate her suggested revisions to the March 6 minutes.
allegations.key_passage: as the minutes satisfied the requirements of the Law, the Committee was under no obligation to accept the proposed additions.
